Product description

FEIDUSUN SUNGLASSES PROTECT YOUR EYES WITH STYLE

We designed our polarized sunglasses to protect your eyes while you are out under the harmful sun UV rays and to make you look attractive at the same time.

  • HD polarized 7 layer lens
  • UV protective
  • Blocks glare and strong light.
  • Restore true color
  • Multiple colors for you to choose

  • TR90 material arms
  • Ergonomic arm design
  • Light-weight feature
  • Can effectively reduce the pressure on the arms of the frame

  • Reinforced metal hinge design
  • Three-tier connection
  • More strong and durable
  • No noise Expand

  • High resistance to pressure
  • Maximum pressure limit: 100lb
  • Not easy to break
  • Not easily deformed

Lens Detail

  • The 1st layer is polarized layer.
  • The 2nd and 4th and 5th layers enable durability.
  • The 3rd and 6th and 7th layers are reinforced layers to ensure durability and solidity.

Our polarized driving sunglasses not noly have the fashionable style but also have the Humanized Design. Strong, light-weight frame and Silicone nose pad give you different wearing feelings.

Tips

1-Never clean your sunglasses with paper towels or clothing, which can leave scratches.Just use clean water and included cloth to clean it.

2-Never leave your sunglasses under car's front window, especially in summer. Prolonged exposure to the oven-like temperatures inside a car can degrade the lens.

Polarized effect

Enjoy the beautiful world

The HD polarized lens of our mens sunglasses offer true color perception by eliminating reflected and scattered light.

Therefore you will be able to enjoy the sunglasses during all outdoor activities, driving, fishing or any water sport as well.

JUST IMAGINE HOW GOOD YOU WILL FEEL not having to worry about eyes health while being able to enjoy and admire the world in every beautiful detail.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Great Polarized Sunglasses for the Price
    Reviewed in the United States on May 19, 2025
    Color: A01-matte Black / Black

    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I picked up a pair of the FEIDUSUN Polarized Sunglasses a few months back, and they've honestly become one of my go-to accessories whenever I head out. I was on the hunt for a good pair of polarized sunglasses that were both stylish and effective at protecting my eyes, and I think I've definitely found that with these.

    The black retro design is really classic and versatile. They go with pretty much any outfit I wear, whether I'm dressed casually or a bit more put-together. I like the clean and simple look of them, and more importantly, they feel really comfortable on my face. They're not too heavy, and they don't pinch my nose or the sides of my head, even after wearing them for several hours, which is a big plus for me. I've had sunglasses in the past that become uncomfortable after a while, but these have been great.

    But beyond the looks, what really stands out about these sunglasses is their performance. The polarized lenses make a significant difference in reducing glare. I notice it most when I'm driving on a sunny day or when I'm around water. The clarity of vision is so much better, and my eyes feel less strained. I've even worn them while fishing, and the difference in being able to see below the surface of the water was noticeable. It really cuts down on that harsh reflected light.

    UV protection is, of course, crucial, and I feel confident that my eyes are well-protected with these sunglasses. That gives me peace of mind, especially during those really bright sunny days we get here. Knowing that I'm shielding my eyes from harmful rays is a big factor in why I choose to wear them.

    After using them pretty regularly for the past few months, I can also say that they seem to be quite durable. They've been tossed into my bag countless times, and they still look and function perfectly. The hinges feel sturdy, and the lenses haven't scratched easily, which is always a concern with sunglasses. I'm not exactly the most careful person with my accessories, so the fact that these have held up well is a testament to their build quality.

    One thing I appreciate is that they don't feel flimsy or cheap. For the price point, I was pleasantly surprised by the overall quality. They feel like a more expensive pair of sunglasses than they actually are.

    Whether I'm driving, walking around town, or just relaxing outdoors, these FEIDUSUN sunglasses have become my constant companion. They provide the right amount of shade without making everything look too dark, and the polarization really enhances visual clarity.

    In short, the FEIDUSUN Polarized Sunglasses are an excellent buy for anyone looking for a stylish, comfortable, and effective pair of polarized sunglasses. They do a fantastic job of reducing glare and protecting against UV rays, and they seem to be built to last. I'm really happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend them to others.
